### Verification Evidence & Fact / Inference Analysis

#### 1. Fresh-Worktree Checkout Stability & EOL Attribute
* **Observed Facts**:
  * `git check-attr eol -- orchestration/continuity/model-required-bureau-a3-b3/rayleen-a3-attempt-1-occupied-audit.jsonl` returned `eol: lf`.
  * The SHA-256 hash of `orchestration/continuity/model-required-bureau-a3-b3/rayleen-a3-attempt-1-occupied-audit.jsonl` is `27d665f162ead5ee70d9db9cb39500bbe621e63b5bc0168b91ec6fb43d82bcad`.
  * Line 17 of [.gitattributes](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-a3-b3-gemini-review-9/.gitattributes#L17) sets `orchestration/continuity/model-required-bureau-a3-b3/*.jsonl text eol=lf`.
* **Inference**: The Review 8 failure was an environment checkout-stability issue under `core.autocrlf=true` where Windows Git converted line endings to CRLF upon checkout. Adding the scoped `text eol=lf` rule in [.gitattributes](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-a3-b3-gemini-review-9/.gitattributes#L17) guarantees LF checkout in fresh worktrees without mutating the immutable audit log or affecting unrelated file formats.
